package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

func (client Client) GetAssignedLessonContext(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID, itemID string) (domain.AssignedLessonContext, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(pathID) + "/items/" + url.PathEscape(itemID) + "/lesson-context")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest || response.StatusCode == http.StatusConflict || response.StatusCode == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	}
	if !studentJSONMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable
	}
	if len(body) > maximumResponseBytes || !utf8.Valid(body) {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	var payload domain.AssignedLessonContext
	if err := decodeStrict(bytes.NewReader(body), &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if assignedContextFields(body, &fields) != nil || len(fields) != 9 {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"schema", "student_id", "learning_path_id", "learning_path_item_id", "course_id", "lesson_id", "lesson_revision_id", "content_digest", "content"} {
		raw, ok := fields[key]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
			return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	}
	var content map[string]json.RawMessage
	if assignedContextFields(fields["content"], &content) != nil || len(content) != 3 {
		return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"title", "excerpt", "description"} {
		raw, ok := content[key]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
			return domain.AssignedLessonContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
	}
	return domain.NormalizeAssignedLessonContext(payload, studentID, pathID, itemID)
}

func assignedContextFields(data []byte, fields *map[string]json.RawMessage) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	result := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for decoder.More() {
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		name, ok := token.(string)
		if !ok {
			return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		if _, present := result[name]; present {
			return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		var raw json.RawMessage
		if decoder.Decode(&raw) != nil {
			return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
		}
		result[name] = raw
	}
	if _, err := decoder.Token(); err != nil {
		return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	if decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	*fields = result
	return nil
}

var _ repository.StudentAssignedLessonContextReader = Client{}
